title: ArgoCast: physics-informed forecasting of Argo temperature and salinity profiles in the Arabian Sea
description:
ArgoCast forecasts the next temperature and salinity profile of an Argo float in the Arabian Sea on 16 standard pressure levels (5 to 1000 dbar). The forecasting model is a two-layer bidirectional LSTM trained with a TEOS-10 static-stability penalty, with Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty bands, Integrated Gradients attributions and evidence links to similar observed Argo profiles.

The release contains the FastAPI backend and trained model artifacts, the React web interface, the data preparation pipeline and the thirteen-model benchmark and experiment scripts used in the accompanying manuscript submitted to Ocean Dynamics.
